---
title: "Overview"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
      dark: darkly
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/status.R")
library(reactable)

status <- read_status()
tab <- status_table(status)
n <- nrow(tab)

n_health <- table(factor(tab$health, levels = c("ok", "warning", "error")))
n_cran <- table(factor(tab$cran_status, levels = c("cran", "archived", "none")))
cran_failing <- sum(tab$cran_checks %in% c("ERROR", "FAILURE"))
cran_warning <- sum(tab$cran_checks %in% "WARNING")
universe_failing <- sum(
  (!is.na(tab$universe_build) & tab$universe_build != "success") |
    tab$universe_checks %in% c("WARNING", "ERROR", "FAILURE")
)
unreleased <- tab[tab$unreleased, ]
with_prs <- tab[!is.na(tab$open_prs) & tab$open_prs > 0, ]
```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste(n_health[["ok"]], "OK,", n_health[["warning"]], "need attention,", n_health[["error"]], "need action")
list(icon = "box-seam", color = if (n_health[["error"]]) "danger" else if (n_health[["warning"]]) "warning" else "success", value = paste(n, "packages"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste(n_cran[["archived"]], "archived,", n_cran[["none"]], "not on CRAN")
list(icon = "check2-circle", color = "primary", value = paste(n_cran[["cran"]], "on CRAN"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste("CRAN checks:", cran_warning, "with warnings")
list(
  icon = "clipboard-check",
  color = if (cran_failing) "danger" else if (cran_warning) "warning" else "success",
  value = if (cran_failing) paste(cran_failing, "failing") else "All passing"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste("r-universe:", sum(!is.na(tab$universe_build)), "of", n, "packages built")
list(
  icon = "boxes",
  color = if (universe_failing) "warning" else "success",
  value = if (universe_failing) paste(universe_failing, "failing") else "All passing"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Unreleased changes on GitHub"
list(icon = "git", color = "info", value = nrow(unreleased))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste(sum(tab$open_prs, na.rm = TRUE), "pull requests")
list(icon = "chat-left-text", color = "secondary", value = paste(sum(tab$open_issues, na.rm = TRUE), "open issues"))
```

## Row

### Column {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: Needs attention
issues <- status_issues(status, levels = c("error", "warning"))

reactable(
  issues[c("package", "level", "text")],
  pagination = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  sortable = FALSE,
  columns = list(
    package = colDef(name = "Package", maxWidth = 170, cell = function(value, index) {
      a(href = issues$github_url[index], value)
    }),
    level = colDef(name = "", maxWidth = 150, cell = function(value) {
      badge(c(error = "Action needed", warning = "Needs attention")[[value]], status_colour[[value]])
    }),
    text = colDef(name = "Problem")
  ),
  language = reactableLang(noData = "Nothing needs attention.")
)
```

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: Unreleased changes
reactable(
  unreleased[c("package", "cran_version", "github_version", "last_commit")],
  pagination = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    package = colDef(name = "Package", cell = function(value, index) {
      a(href = unreleased$github_url[index], value)
    }),
    cran_version = colDef(name = "CRAN"),
    github_version = colDef(name = "GitHub"),
    last_commit = colDef(name = "Last commit", format = colFormat(date = TRUE))
  ),
  language = reactableLang(noData = "All CRAN packages are up to date with GitHub.")
)
```

```{r}
#| title: Open pull requests
with_prs <- with_prs[order(-with_prs$open_prs), ]
reactable(
  with_prs[c("package", "open_prs")],
  pagination = FALSE,
  compact = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    package = colDef(name = "Package"),
    open_prs = colDef(name = "Open pull requests", cell = function(value, index) {
      a(href = paste0(with_prs$github_url[index], "/pulls"), value)
    })
  ),
  language = reactableLang(noData = "No open pull requests.")
)
```
